newsitem.title: FINLAND: Huhtamaki says Santen to buy Star.
newsitem.headline: Huhtamaki says Santen to buy Star.

text.p: Finnish confectionery and packaging materials group Huhtamaki Oy said in a statement on Monday that Santen Pharmaceuticals Co Ltd of Japan will buy its Star eye medicine unit for 430 million markka.
"The world's second largest eye medicine producer, Osaka-based Santen Pharmaceutical, will buy Huhtamaki's eye medicine unit, Star," Huhtamaki said.

After the deal, which is due to be completed in early 1997, Huhtamaki no longer has any businesses linked with health care, and will concentrate on its Leaf confectionery business and Polarcup food packaging business, it said.
Huhtamaki earlier this year sold its Leiras pharmaceuticals business to Germany's Schering for 1.43 billion markka.
